text: Thien nhan luong tam la goc re cua dao duc. Song o doi phai biet yeu thuong dong loai, chia se ngot bui va khong ngung phan dau vi tuong lai tuoi sang cua que huong.
source: Triet ly nhan sinh Viet Nam

text: Vi loi ich muoi nam thi phai trong cay, vi loi ich tram nam thi phai trong nguoi. Giao duc la quoc sach hang dau de xay dung dat nuoc phon vinh va van minh.
source: Ho Chi Minh, Bai noi ve giao duc

text: Ngoc kia mai moi thanh do, nguoi co hoc moi biet dao ly o doi. Dung ngai gian kho, boi vi lua thu vang gian nan thu suc nhung con nguoi co y chi kien cuong.

Non song Viet Nam co tro nen tuoi dep hay khong, dan toc Viet Nam co buoc toi dai vinh quang de sanh vai voi cac cuong quoc nam chau duoc hay khong, chinh la nho mot phan lon o cong hoc tap cua cac em.
source: Ho Chi Minh, Thu gui hoc sinh nhan ngay khai truong

text: May bay qua nui roi may tan, nguoi song tram nam nghia van con. Lay chu duc lam dau, chu tam lam trong, do la le song muon doi cua to tien.
source: Ca dao dan ca Viet Nam
